description: This file defines the 'User' class within the Goteo project. It handles user data management, including user creation, validation, role management, profile updates, and various user-related database operations. It also includes methods for authentication, preferences, and related functionalities.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Main class for managing user data, authentication, roles, and preferences within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: idealiza
methods.description: Prepares or formats a value, with optional precision and formatting parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing user instance, setting default avatar and node data.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic getter for deferred property evaluation like support, investments, worth, etc.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns fields that are language-dependent for localization.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the user's Image instance for avatar access.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and persists user data to the database, handling new and existing users.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates user data fields before save, including email, password, and other profile info.

methods.name: isGhost
methods.description: Determines if the user is a ghost (non-registered or social login only).

methods.name: rebase
methods.description: Changes key user identifiers such as ID, email, or password, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates user's email and password directly, deprecated in favor of more specific methods.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets or updates the user's email, optionally with token validation.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Changes the user's password, encoding it securely unless raw is specified.

methods.name: getAvailableLangs
methods.description: Returns a list of available languages based on user and preference data.

methods.name: updateLang
methods.description: Updates the user's preferred language in the database.

methods.name: updateNode
methods.description: Updates the user's assigned node in the database.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a user object by ID, with options for language and password retrieval.

methods.name: getMini
methods.description: Fetches minimal user info for listing purposes.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a filtered list of users based on various criteria such as role, interest, node, etc.

methods.name: getAllMini
methods.description: Returns a simple list of all users with ID and formatted name.

methods.name: getOwners
methods.description: Returns a list of users who are project owners.

methods.name: isOwner
methods.description: Checks if a user is an owner of any project, optionally only published ones.

methods.name: getCallers
methods.description: Returns a list of users with the role 'caller'.

methods.name: getAdmins
methods.description: Returns a list of users with admin or superadmin roles, optionally only those without assigned nodes.

methods.name: getVips
methods.description: Returns a list of users with the 'vip' role.

methods.name: getByEmail
methods.description: Fetches a user object based on email, with optional language and password inclusion.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user by username or email and password, returning the user object if valid.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the user's password hash from the database.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.description: Checks if a provided password matches the stored hash.

methods.name: getPool
methods.description: Returns the user's investment pool object.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Returns the user roles object.

methods.name: getProjectNames
methods.description: Returns a list of project names owned by the user.

methods.name: getTotalProjects
methods.description: Returns the total number of projects owned by the user.

methods.name: getTotalPublishedProjects
methods.description: Returns the number of published projects owned.

methods.name: getInvests
methods.description: Gets a list of investments by the user.

methods.name: getTotalInvests
methods.description: Returns the total count of investments by the user.

methods.name: getMailing
methods.description: Returns a list of mailing sent to the user.

methods.name: getTotalMailing
methods.description: Returns total number of mailings sent.

methods.name: hasPerm
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission.

methods.name: hasRole
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific role.

methods.name: getLegacyRoles
methods.description: Gets roles assigned to the user in legacy format for backward compatibility.

methods.name: getRolesList
methods.description: Returns list of roles available for assignment.

methods.name: getNodeRole
methods.description: Fetches the user's highest role in a specific node.

methods.name: hasRoleInNode
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific role within a node.

methods.name: getNodeNames
methods.description: Returns list of all node names.

methods.name: getAdminNodes
methods.description: Returns nodes where the user has admin roles.

methods.name: getAllNodeRoles
methods.description: Gets all node-role associations for the user.

methods.name: getAllNodeRolesRaw
methods.description: Retrieves raw node-role data without hierarchy processing.

methods.name: canImpersonate
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to impersonate another user.

methods.name: canRebase
methods.description: Checks if the user can rebase (modify) another user's data.

methods.name: canChangeRole
methods.description: Checks if the user can change roles of others.

methods.name: canAdminRoleInNode
methods.description: Checks if the user can administer roles in a specific node.

methods.name: delRoleFromNode
methods.description: Removes a role assignment from a user in a node.

methods.name: addRoleToNode
methods.description: Assigns a role to a user in a node.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Refreshes the user session data.

methods.name: recover
methods.description: Initiates a account recovery process via email token.

methods.name: leaving
methods.description: Handles user account deactivation and sends confirmation emails.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets a token on the user, often for email confirmation or password reset.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the user's token.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the user's location data object.

methods.name: isFavouriteProject
methods.description: Checks if a project is marked as favorite by the user.

methods.name: getSupport
methods.description: Returns data about the user's co-financing activities.

methods.name: numInvested
methods.description: Calculates and returns the number of projects the user has invested in.

methods.name: getSupport
methods.description: Retrieves the projects, total invested amount, and number of investments for the user’s cofinancing support.

methods.name: numInvested
methods.description: Calculates the total number of projects invested in by the user, updating the user record if changed.

methods.name: updateWorth
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the user's 'worth' level based on invested amount.

methods.name: updateOwned
methods.description: Updates the count of projects owned by the user based on published projects.

methods.name: updateAmount
methods.description: Updates the total amount invested by the user.

methods.name: getPersonal
methods.description: Retrieves the user's personal data fields from the database.

methods.name: setPersonal
methods.description: Sets or updates the user's personal data, with options to force replace.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Fetches user notification and interface preferences.

methods.name: setPreferences
methods.description: Sets or updates user preferences for notifications.

methods.name: invested
methods.description: Retrieves projects the user has invested in, with filters for public visibility, pagination, and uniqueness.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Deactivates and hides a user account without deleting data.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets specific boolean properties (active, hide, rememberme) in user record.

methods.name: mailBlock
methods.description: Checks if a user has blocked a specific mailing type.

methods.name: isTranslated
methods.description: Checks if the user has a translation record in a specific language.

methods.name: isInvestor
methods.description: Checks if the user has invested in projects of a specific owner.

methods.name: isParticipant
methods.description: Checks if the user has participated in messaging on projects of a specific owner.

methods.name: suggestUserId
methods.description: Generates suggested user IDs based on input strings, avoiding existing IDs.

methods.name: getTotalUsers
methods.description: Returns the total number of active users in Goteo.
